scope: CAD feasibility with route_open_join.py (--rip/--keepout) and place_passive.py; rules unchanged (0.2 mm track/clearance, via 0.45/0.2, hole clearance 0.25).

attempts.hypothesis: R507/R511 have no copper and no verified pair: rip the PHY_RXCLK F.Cu detour (U5.27 -> via 63.05,27.69 -> R512.2) and re-place R507/R511
attempts.outcome: no_path at guard 0.7/0.45/0; place_passive: 52 free poses within 3 mm, none routable. The RXCLK via slot is the only via site between R512 (B.Cu) and C517.2/GND trace at y=27; it is <0.425 mm from R512.2 for any other net.

attempts.hypothesis: also park R507/R511/R512, replace the C517.2 GND trace (5acea6f2, via 6a8c8193) with a local GND via, keep F.Cu channels of pins 25/26 free and reroute RXCLK to the left
attempts.outcome: C517.2 GND via route found (0.45 mm, via 63.48,26.75); RXCLK left via site blocked by C517.2 pad (needs y>=27.735) and +3V3_PHY pin-28 track at x=62.0 (0.525 mm via keep-off). no_path.

attempts.hypothesis: TX side pins have no copper; free the escape by ripping the PHY_RESET_N F.Cu loop in front of pins 13-16, the GND via 34504188 + B.Cu trace aa3d6466, and parking R510
attempts.outcome: probe only: U5.18 -> R501.2 still no_path within 2 s (source enclosed). R510.2 carries PHY_RXD3 (not free). Requires re-placing the U5 right-side passives as a group.

dependency: U5 RGMII escapes need a group re-placement of R507/R509-R512/R521/C517 around the PHY (or via-in-pad / smaller vias), not single-join routing.
